spec.question: We propose removing the special rule that an environment value exactly equal to a non-boolean flag's flag_value activates that flag. Such environment values would instead go through the same boolean-string interpretation as other values: recognized true values activate the flag, recognized false values produce False, and unrecognized values leave it unset so normal fallback applies. Boolean flags, ordinary value options, and command-line activation remain unchanged. Which existing tests would newly fail? Return a JSON list of pytest node IDs.
